topic: FXRP live reserve delta, escrow ladder, protocol concentration and supply-contraction counter-hypothesis

sources.method: Flare contract registry and agent calls plus XRPL account_info/account_objects escrow reads at one fixed ledger; site directs users to documented API and prohibits UI scraping.

delta_from_2026_11_01T23_57_22Z.interpretation: Consistent with reserve reallocation plus a smaller net supply/backing reduction, but no transaction path is proven. Reconcile at fixed XRPL ledger indices.

concentration.caveat: Morpho holder category aggregates markets; it is not the same as the isolated FXRP/RLUSD market.

escrow_ladder.cadence: One 10M XRP batch per day, per Flare's first-party description and XRPL.to's historical fixed-ledger analysis.
escrow_ladder.conditions: XRPL.to reports a crypto-condition and a one-day finish/cancel window; unclaimed escrow returns to Core Vault on cancellation.
escrow_ladder.implication: The 140M is not permanently inaccessible, but it is not immediate free liquidity either.

historical_supply_context.caveat: Supply contraction is a counter-hypothesis to accelerating adoption; exact daily burn/redemption series is not yet built.

conclusions: Backing remains slightly above 1:1 in the captured API snapshot.
Backing is operationally concentrated: about 98.94% sits in the Core Vault; the six agent reserve balances total about 1.53M XRP.
The escrow ladder releases capacity in daily tranches if conditions are satisfied; do not equate 140M escrowed with 140M permanently unavailable.
Protocol destinations are concentrated: Firelight, Morpho, bridge and Kinetic represent most FXRP supply.
Supply contraction and the 94% March-to-August mint slowdown are material counter-evidence to a simple accelerating-adoption thesis.
open_questions: Trace the 147,740 XRP Core Vault liquid-balance decline and 129,906 XRP agent-reserve increase at fixed ledger indices.
Revalidate current escrow finish/cancel dates and crypto-conditions.
Rebuild daily FXRP totalSupply, mint/burn/redemption and agent funding history.
Distinguish reserve redistribution from true redemptions and external spot purchases.
Use the documented XRPL.to API rather than scraping/copying its UI.
